target: Apple M4, 16 GiB, macOS 26.2, Rack Pro 2.6.6 arm64
fixture: Core Audio Audio-2 and Fundamental VCO, two CV Bridges in buffered mode, Test Image, two processors, explicit feedback delay, Monitor, simultaneous Syphon receive/publish; eight RVX nodes and nine video edges

native_renderer.timing_scope: Cumulative completed renders since worker start, including startup. The >600-second native log span ends while the external source remains active. Quantiles use fixed 0.05 ms upper-bound buckets through 100 ms; zero saturated samples. Skipped scheduled ticks are separate from completed-render deadline misses.

sampled_resources.scope: One-second process snapshots during the later eight minutes of the run; sampled maximum is not a kernel high-water mark. Total Rack RSS includes host/libraries and is distinct from RVX current frame accounting.

limits: CoreAudio notifications are device-wide; Rack ignores RtAudioStreamStatus and exposes no internal underrun/zero-fill/drop counts.
The Syphon active receive window starts after initial server discovery; receive FPS is observed, not metadata. Frame counts use received FramePtr identity plus pixel hashes.
Other Rack processes and development activity remained present in baseline and stress; this is not an isolated machine capacity limit.
No cables feed hardware audio outputs. Physical unplug/reconnect and end-to-end audiovisual latency remain untested.

measurement_tools.stage: Temporary predecessors of the opt-in tools adopted in b1a4b95; these runs did not use the later packaged probe binaries

post_run_review_limit: The predecessor probe success flag is not accepted as proof of the external-source-to-Rack path. Internal TestImage/VCO can animate output with missing external input; selection used only output server name; three changing frames could pass despite later outage. These counters remain scoped observations, not verified incoming-source contribution or output application identity.
